narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: Tells the story of Israel in Egypt and the call of Moses.

moses.name: Moses
moses.note: Hebrew raised in Pharaoh's house, shepherd in Madian; hesitant and awed before God, pleading for his people.

pharaohs-daughter.name: Pharaoh's daughter
pharaohs-daughter.note: Egyptian princess who finds the infant Moses; compassionate, used to command.

miriam.name: Miriam
miriam.note: Moses' sister as a girl, watching the basket; quick and bold.

jethro.name: Jethro (Raguel)
jethro.note: Priest of Madian, Moses' father in law; hospitable and kindly.

hebrew-man.name: A quarrelling Hebrew
hebrew-man.note: The man in the wrong, rebuked by Moses; defiant and sneering.

jethros-daughters.name: The daughters of Raguel
jethros-daughters.note: Seven shepherdess sisters reporting to their father; eager.

1.t: After this there went a man of the house of Levi; and took a wife of his own kindred.

2.t: And she conceived, and bore a son: and seeing him a goodly child, hid him three months.

3.t: And when she could hide him no longer, she took a basket made of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and pitch: and put the little babe therein, and laid him in the sedges by the river's brink,

4.t: His sister standing afar off, and taking notice what would be done.

5.t: And behold the daughter of Pharao came down to wash herself in the river: and her maids walked by the river's brink. And when she saw the basket in the sedges she sent one of her maids for it: and when it was brought,

6.t: She opened it, and seeing within it an infant crying, having compassion on it, she said:
This is one of the babes of the Hebrews.

7.t: And the child's sister said to her:
Shall I go, and call to thee a Hebrew woman, to nurse the babe?

8.t: The maid went and called her mother.

9.t: And Pharao's daughter said to her:
Take this child, and nurse him for me: I will give thee thy wages.
The woman took and nursed the child: and when he was grown up, she delivered him to Pharao's daughter.

10.t: And she adopted him for a son, and called him Moses, saying:
Because I took him out of the water.

11.t: In those days, after Moses was grown up, he went out to his brethren: and saw their affliction, and an Egyptian striking one of the Hebrews, his brethren.

12.t: And when he had looked about this way and that way, and saw no one there, he slew the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.

13.t: And going out the next day, he saw two Hebrews quarrelling: and he said to him that did the wrong:

14.t: Who hath appointed thee prince and judge over us? wilt thou kill me, as thou didst yesterday kill the Egyptian?
How is this come to be known?

15.t: And Pharao heard of this word, and sought to kill Moses: but he fled from his sight, and abode in the land of Madian, and he sat down by a well.

16.t: And the priest of Madian had seven daughters, who came to draw water: and when the troughs were filled, desired to water their father's flocks.

17.t: And the shepherds came and drove them away: and Moses arose, and defending the maids, watered their sheep.

18.t: And when they returned to Raguel their father, he said to them:
Why are ye come sooner than usual?

19.t: A man of Egypt delivered us from the hands of the shepherds: and he drew water also with us, and gave the sheep to drink.

20.t: Where is he? why have you let the man go? call him that he may eat bread.

21.t: And Moses swore that he would dwell with him. And he took Sephora his daughter to wife:

22.t: And she bore him a son, whom he called Gersam, saying:
I have been a stranger in a foreign country.
And she bore another, whom he called Eliezer, saying:
For the God of my father, my helper, hath delivered me out of the hand of Pharao.

23.t: Now after a long time the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel groaning, cried out because of the works: and their cry went up unto God from the works.

24.t: And he heard their groaning, and remembered the covenant which he made with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

25.t: And the Lord looked upon the children of Israel, and he knew them.
